positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed a distributed application with a data warehouse to allow for high throughput. 

Worked with a number of different NoSql data stores including: MongoDB, Riak, Elasticsearch.

Developed custom modules for DotNetNuke using OWS, SQL, jQuery.

Worked with clients to build and deploy custom ASP.Net, DotNetNuke web portals.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Developed Pocket PC, Windows Mobile, Windows CE scanner applications using C# and SQL replication.

Interfaced an API to the back end licencing system.
